temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hospital hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation; Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated and hardworking, but before this event he may not have fully understood how severely Gary's health and work-life balance are suffering.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Seeing Gary's extreme work habits and hearing his refusal confirms that Gary's overwork is serious and that professional obligations are currently preventing him from resting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is dangerously overworked and overly committed to hospital duties, with his health at risk; Gary is not yet willing or able to step away.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and disappointed by the refusal, but still caring and determined to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene supportively, encourage Gary to take a break, and find a way to help him prioritize his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is severely overworked by hospital demands and that his health is suffering; he may think the main issue is workload and poor balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and vague response suggest the overwork is tied to deeper personal or professional problems beyond ordinary hospital busyness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is hiding or struggling with something more complicated than workload alone, but Gary has not yet disclosed the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, suspicious that something deeper is wrong, empathetic, and gently worried.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary with care, reassure him he can speak safely, and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Ethan learns the reasons behind Gary's overwork and offers practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and hiding deeper complications, but he does not yet know the specific causes or how to address them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's disclosure explains the overwork as a mix of new departmental pressure and personal challenges, making the problem more understandable and potentially manageable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is under significant pressure but that the causes are now clear enough to work on; with support, Gary can find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relieved that Gary opened up, empathetic, caring, and cautiously optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, organize his schedule, and make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, he is less overwhelmed, and he even had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is under significant pressure but can improve with support, structure, and better work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and visible efforts show that the support is working and that Gary is making real progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is gradually achieving a healthier balance and is no longer as overwhelmed as before, though continued encouragement may still help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encourage Gary's progress, and remain available whenever Gary needs to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and seems capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been making steady progress and is improving, though Ethan may still see himself as an active support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control show that he can now manage independently without Ethan's active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary has achieved a healthy work-life balance and no longer needs close monitoring or hands-on support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy for Gary, relieved, and proud.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active involvement while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
